SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "event_space" IN ('Banquet Hall', 'Conference Room')
    AND "capacity" >= 200;

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'Restaurant'
    OR (r."food_service" = 'Café' AND r."cuisine" = 'Italian')
ORDER BY
    r."food_service",
    r."name";

    r."address",
    r."food_service"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian'
    AND LOWER(r."food_service") IN ('restaurant', 'café');

SELECT mr."rolename", mr."salary"
FROM "medicalroles" mr
WHERE mr."roleid" IN (
    SELECT hmr."roleid"
    FROM "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr
    GROUP BY hmr."roleid"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") = (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid")
        FROM "hospitals"
    )
);

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_name";
110:
SELECT
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active",
    its."name" AS "it_specialist_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
CROSS JOIN
    "systems" s
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
    AND s."system_id" = itss."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id",
    s."system_id";

    its."id" AS it_specialist_id,

    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id";
112:
WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total
    FROM
        "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM

SELECT
    "position"."title" AS "position_title",
    "salarydetails"."salary_range" AS "salary_range",
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "hourly_rate"
FROM
    "position"
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" ON "position"."id" = "salarydetails"."positionid"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer');
263:

    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer');
